basic_identification.full_title: Agro Textiles — Laminated Woven Orchard Protection Covers — Specification
basic_identification.sector_category: Technical Textiles / Technical Textiles for Agrotech Applications (approved by the Textile Division Council and finalized by the Technical Textiles for Agrotech Sectional Committee of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

sectional_committee.name: Technical Textiles for Agrotech Sectional Committee

scope.summary: This standard specifies the construction, dimensions, material, physical, and mechanical performance requirements for laminated woven polymeric agro-textile covers. These covers are specifically engineered to shield fruit orchards, vineyards, and nurseries from adverse weather conditions (including hailstorms, frost, and heavy rainfall), manage optical conditions through light diffusion, and retard pest growth.

certification_and_marking.standard_type: Product Specification (Agrotech Textiles / Crop Protection Materials)
certification_and_marking.certification_status: Strict Statutory Mandatory Certification. Under the 'Agro Textiles (Quality Control) Order' (Agrotech QCO) issued by the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India, all Laminated Woven Orchard Protection Covers manufactured, imported, distributed, or sold in India must conform to IS 17731:2021 and carry the mandatory BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark). Manufacturing, importing, distributing, or stocking non-certified orchard covers in the Indian market is a statutory offense under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016. MSMEs are granted phased transition timelines, and export-only shipments are exempt. Precious metal hallmarking is completely inapplicable to synthetic woven laminates.

requirements.detail: Every commercial roll or pack of orchard protection cover must bear the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) along with the manufacturer's registered licence number (CM/L) and standard designation (IS 17731) on a secure label or edge tape.

Orchard protection covers are constructed from high-quality High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) woven fabrics laminated with Low-Density Polyethylene (LDPE) and fortified with specialized UV-stabilized additives to resist weathering and sun-bleaching.

Woven laminated covers are commonly produced in standard weights such as 140 GSM (g/m²) and 160 GSM, as declared by the manufacturer. Mass tolerances must stay within strictly bounded limits to ensure uniform material density.
To guarantee thermal insulation and physical barrier durability, the thickness of the laminated sheet must meet specified minimum values (mm, Min).

The cover must withstand wind shear and hailstorm forces. Average warpway and weftway breaking strength must be tested as per the strip method of IS 1969 (Part 1) and exceed specified minimum thresholds (N, Min).

requirements.requirement_type: Accelerated UV stability and Strength Retention (Table 1 - iv)
requirements.detail: To ensure long-term outdoor field performance (expected 4 to 5 years service life), the fabric must undergo 1000 hours of accelerated UV weathering and retain a high percentage of its original actual breaking strength (percent, Min).
The fabric must show controlled elasticity to absorb physical impacts. Elongation/strain limits (percent) are strictly evaluated at peak breaking load.

The cover must resist falling hail and heavy rain. It must meet a specified minimum impact failure load when evaluated at a standard 1524 mm drop height (expressed as gram force at 50 percent failure).
For Type II covers, the integrated reinforced band must exhibit outstanding tensile strength (N, Min) to handle tight rope-tying and anchoring on support structures.
To prevent excessive inorganic fillers that degrade polymer performance, the ash content of the material is limited to a strict maximum percentage (percent, Max).

To maintain optimal horticultural growth conditions and prevent excessive heat buildup, the cover must satisfy specified total visible light transmission parameters (percent) to diffuse direct summer sun.

For secure installations, the covers are loosely placed on support frames and secured using brass or synthetic eyelets along the reinforced edges, allowing them to be tied tightly with flexible ropes.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 17731 : 2021 is the mandatory national Indian Standard specification governing laminated woven orchard protection covers used in the agricultural and horticultural sectors to shield fruit orchards, vineyards, and nurseries (especially berries, grapes, cherries, and pomegranates) from hailstorms, frost, and torrential rains. Under India's statutory Agro Textiles Quality Control Order (QCO), all laminated woven orchard covers sold or imported domestically must bear the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark). Crafted from UV-stabilized HDPE woven fabric laminated with LDPE, they provide total water proofing and diffuse summer light to prevent heat traps. The standard classifies covers into Type I (without reinforcement band) and Type II (with reinforced edges and center bands), enforcing strict limits on mechanical thickness, warpway/weftway breaking strength, elongation, a specialized 1524 mm dart drop impact failure test, 1000-hour UV accelerated weathering resistance, and total light transmission percentages.
